SELECT p.Id,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Votes v WHERE v.PostId = p.Id) AS NVotos,
  (SELECT MAX(v.CreationDate) FROM dbo.Votes v WHERE v.PostId = p.Id) AS UltimoVoto
FROM dbo.Posts p WHERE p.OwnerUserId = 22656

SELECT p.Id, COUNT(v.Id) AS NVotos, MAX(v.CreationDate) AS UltimoVoto
FROM dbo.Posts p LEFT JOIN dbo.Votes v ON v.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.OwnerUserId = 22656 GROUP BY p.Id
